The '''Motti family''' was a clan of wealthy and influental [[Human/Legends|Humans]] centralized on [[Phelarion/Legends|Phelarion]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. They had earned their fortune for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] mainly through [[Mining/Legends|mining]] of [[Megonite moss/Legends|megonite]] [[Moss/Legends|moss]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The earliest known member of the [[Blood/Legends|bloodline]], [[Lithio Motti]], had [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a woman of the [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to secure startup capital for his mining enterprise. Like many [[Noble/Legends|patricians]], the Motti preferred not to intermarry with the lower class but with other nobles.<ref name="Tinker" /> The Motti were known to use [[Slavery/Legends|slave labor]] in order to increase their benefits but had many ties to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republican]]&mdash;and then [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]&mdash;government, which is probably why they never got convicted for that.

As a prominent family from the Seswenna sector, they were related to the [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin]] by at least one [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]], that of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Thalassa Tarkin|Thalassa Motti]] and [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]],<ref name="Manning" /> who was [[Lieutenant governor/Legends|Lieutenant governor]] of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> before being appointed as the first [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]], a nephew of Thalassa,<ref name="G&ORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> also pursued a successful career with the Empire, achieving the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] and becoming the head of [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] operations aboard the planet-killing [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="ds" />
